title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Lobby Full Item Box

preimages.meaning: The Port Tanzia interaction passes box mode 1 in PPC argument r5; the pack changes it to unrestricted mode 0.

anchors.meaning: The shared box initializer stores its third PPC argument as the mode byte at object offset +0x6E12.
The shared box initializer compares the mode argument with restricted mode 1.
The unrestricted path begins with menu-state value 6.
Modes other than 1 keep the unrestricted value 6.
Restricted mode 1 replaces the menu-state value with 3.
The selected unrestricted/restricted menu-state value is stored in the shared box state.
The sibling full-box interaction already passes unrestricted mode 0 to the same initializer.
The sibling full-box interaction calls the shared box initializer at 0x021F0A8C.
The Port Tanzia interaction calls the same shared box initializer immediately after the patched mode argument.
